derivation: from an unused root meaning to heap together;

occurrences.text: The Lord shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
